subject: Getting pot data as an ecel file or csv file

messages.author: 1c8e730f60d904f5
messages.subject: Getting pot data as an ecel file or csv file
parts:
Good afternoon Dr Matias,
I hope you are doing well. 
After identifying the plots, Is there any possibility to get or extract each RGB band for each plot as an excel file or csv file. 
Thanks a lot.

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Getting pot data as an ecel file or csv file
parts:
Hi there,
Thanks for asking...!

The answer is YES, it is possible. After making the plot shape file you can use the function fieldInfo (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P9). Basically, you should inform the mosaic (RGB or vegetation indices) and the fieldShape file and all bands will be extracted for each plot. To save this information in one CSV file (NewData.csv) you can use the following code:

Info <- fieldInfo(mosaic = RGB, fieldShape = fieldShape) 
NewData <- Info$fieldShape@data
write.csv(NewData, "NewData.csv", row.names = F, col.names = T)

Let me know if it works well for you.
All the best,
Filipe
